features.name: any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly quote specific wording from the original post and refute that quoted wording within the same comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments). Read title and argument only to verify that quoted text is the OP's wording. Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly quotes or near-verbatim reproduces a specific phrase from the OP's title or argument (quotation marks or blockquote/'>' formatting) and (b) in that same comment argues against, disputes or refutes that quoted phrase. Quote and refutation must co-occur in one comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Return 0 if no comment does so, including quoting without refuting, refuting without quoting, or quoting non-OP text. Empty comment list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments, title or argument gives null. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates and reports of the outcome as evidence; generic delta-rule discussion is eligible.

h0: any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase = 1 have a higher likelihood of view change (delta) than those with 0.
note: Operationalized as at least one comment (any, not share) with quote and refutation in the same comment. Comment order/timing unknown. OC_comments and the OP text may contain outcome announcements; semantic spec excludes them. Association only. OP text is current, possibly edited. Quotes counted only if from OP text.
